workouts.title: Upper Body
workouts.subtitle: Hand Violence, Punch Power & Shoulder Armor
workouts.focus: Pressing strength to lock out offensive linemen, pulling power to shed blocks, and shoulder stability for contact durability.

exercises.name: Barbell Bench Press
exercises.cue: Tuck elbows at 45°, drive feet into the turf, explode up like punching a blocker's chest plate.

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Press
exercises.cue: Control 2-second lowering; keep wrists stacked directly over elbows.

exercises.name: Chest-Supported or Pendlay Barbell Row
exercises.cue: Snap bar to lower ribs with a flat back — builds pull-and-shed power.

exercises.name: Weighted Pull-Ups (or Lat Pulldown)
exercises.cue: Full hang at bottom, drive elbows down to pockets to anchor lats.

exercises.name: Half-Kneeling Dumbbell Overhead Press
exercises.cue: Brace glutes and abs; press straight up without arching lower back.

exercises.name: Band Face Pulls + External Rotation
exercises.cue: Pull thumbs toward ears and pause 1 second to protect rotator cuffs from contact.

exercises.name: Heavy Dumbbell Farmer's Carry
exercises.cue: Crush the handles, tall posture, brisk controlled steps — builds grip to rip off blocks.

workouts.title: Lower Body
workouts.subtitle: Hip Drive, Base Anchor & Double-Team Resistance
workouts.focus: Ground-up force production so you stay low out of your stance, hold your gap against double teams, and drive blockers backward.

exercises.name: Barbell Back Squat (or Trap-Bar Squat)
exercises.cue: Break hips and knees together, hit parallel, drive hard through mid-foot out of the hole.

exercises.name: Barbell Romanian Deadlift (RDL)
exercises.cue: Push hips straight back with soft knees; feel hamstring tension before snapping hips forward.

exercises.name: Rear-Foot Elevated Split Squat
exercises.cue: Keep front shin vertical to build single-leg push-off power when changing direction.

exercises.name: Heavy Prowler / Sled Drive (Low Pad)
exercises.cue: 45° torso angle, flat back, piston knees forward — mimic bull-rushing an offensive tackle.

exercises.name: Nordic Curl or Slider Leg Curl
exercises.cue: Control the eccentric lowering to bulletproof hamstrings during sprint bursts.

exercises.name: Band Pallof Press + Dead Bug
exercises.cue: Resist rotation under tension so blockers cannot turn your shoulders.

workouts.title: Explosive Days
workouts.subtitle: Snap Get-Off, Triple Extension & Violent Hips
workouts.focus: High-velocity power with full rest between sets. Quality and bar/jump speed beat fatigue on every single rep.

exercises.name: Hang Power Clean (or Trap-Bar Jump Shrug)
exercises.cue: Violent hip extension + shrug before catching high; reset each rep if bar speed drops.

exercises.name: Box Jump (Step Down Each Rep)
exercises.cue: Snap arms and hips explosively; land softly in an athletic quarter-squat, step down safely.

exercises.name: Broad Jump from 3-Point DL Stance
exercises.cue: React on 'Set-Go' or clap; no false step — fire straight out of your hips.

exercises.name: Med Ball Explosive Chest Pass (8-12 lb)
exercises.cue: Step forward into a punch and throw through the wall — trains rapid hand strike.

exercises.name: Med Ball Rotational Slam / Scoop Toss
exercises.cue: Load back hip, whip hips and torso together like ripping past a guard.

exercises.name: Light Banded Squat Jumps (or DB Jump Squat)
exercises.cue: Minimal ground contact time; leave the floor fast on every rep.

workouts.title: Running Days
workouts.subtitle: 10-Yard Get-Off, Lateral Pursuit & 4th-Quarter Gas Tank
workouts.focus: Football is played in 4-to-7 second bursts with 25-40 seconds between snaps. Train first-step acceleration, change of direction, and repeat-play stamina.

exercises.name: 10-Yard Get-Off Sprints (3-Pt / 4-Pt Stance)
exercises.cue: Stay low through yards 0-5, violent arm swing, zero wasted vertical pop on step one.

exercises.name: 20-Yard Angled Pursuit Sprints
exercises.cue: Take a sharp pursuit angle like chasing a bubble screen or outside zone stretch.

exercises.name: 5-10-5 Pro Agility Shuttle
exercises.cue: Drop hips before the line, plant outside foot hard, keep shoulders square out of the turn.

exercises.name: 3-Cone L-Drill (Pass Rush Bend)
exercises.cue: Dip inside shoulder around the far cone like turning the corner on an offensive tackle.

exercises.name: Half-Gasser Tempo Intervals (Sideline-Back)
exercises.cue: Controlled athletic stride, crisp turns, practice deep nasal recovery breaths during rest.
